title: Why the stock market is having 'digestion problems' this earnings season - Yahoo Finance
snippet: News Life Entertainment Finance Sports New on Yahoo Yahoo Finance Why the stock market is having 'digestion problems' this earnings season Earnings season hasn't been able to keep the stock market rally afloat over the past week.  Click here for the latest stock market news and in-depth analysis, including events that move stocks Read the latest financial and business news from Yahoo Finance Error in retrieving data Error in retrieving data Sign in to create a watchlist Given the market's recent jitteriness around rising yields and the lack of hope around Fed rate cuts, the performance of these companies will be "pivotal" for the market's direction moving forward, SoFi head of investment strategy Liz Young wrote on X, formerly Twitter, on Friday.  Meanwhile, companies that disappoint on both metrics are taking a bigger hit than normal, with the average stock falling 5.8% in the next trading action, compared to the usual 3.1% decline seen over the past five years.  The top 10 stocks in the S&P 500 — primarily the "Magnificent Seven" — are expected to see earnings grow by 32% in the first quarter.
